note: morph segment lookup off by one at a key frame blends into the previous key
anchor: if frame < Double(keys[mid].frame) { hi = mid } else { lo = mid + 1 }
replacement: if frame <= Double(keys[mid].frame) { hi = mid } else { lo = mid + 1 }

note: morph handles not lerped keep the left key's handles
anchor: out.append(.cubic(control1: lerp(ha.0, hb.0), control2: lerp(ha.1, hb.1), to: lerp(pa, pb)))
replacement: out.append(.cubic(control1: ha.0, control2: ha.1, to: lerp(pa, pb)))

note: morph ignores the key's easing and blends by the raw fraction
quad to cubic elevation puts handles one third of the way to the control
morph quad against quad keeps the left key's control
anchor: out.append(.quad(control: lerp(ca, cb), to: lerp(pa, pb)))

note: unpaired path keys hold the right key instead of the left
